text:
release-lead: Quick weekly train bulletin: short embargo tomorrow 17:30-18:15 PT to roll out improved telemetry hooks and a minor gating tweak. No full freeze but new canaries that opt into the telemetry change will be held until metrics show stable ingest.

rafa: What's the main telemetry change?

release-lead: We're switching to batched metrics export (v2) to reduce cardinality noise. Also adding a new 'regression_signal' derived metric for smoke prompts.

tara: Will the metric rename break dashboards or alerts?

release-lead: We added compatibility aliases; dashboards should auto-resolve. Alert rules updated — please pull latest from infra-alerts repo.

sre-oncall: Abort thresholds? paging behavior?

release-lead: New aborts: if regression_signal > 2.5% for 5m OR canary 5xx > 0.8% for 3m. Alerts include deploy-id and will page #eng-oncall. Oncall can run: `rdeploy rollback --deploy-id ID --reason "telemetry-regress" --no-confirm`

telemetry-bot: Preflight: metrics pipeline green. Will post a readiness ping 1h before window.

rafa: Any Dedicated customer impact?

release-lead: No forced evictions. If a Dedicated pool opts into new metrics agent, we prefer variant routing over disruption. Customers will be notified if we perform agent migration.

tara: I'll update runbooks and the weekly release email blurb.

release-lead: Thanks  Please block 17:15-18:30 PT if you're on pager/list. If anyone sees infra or CI blockers before EOD, flag here. Otherwise we'll proceed with the short embargo and smoke validation. :white_check_mark:
